description_en: Retrieves the effective user scope of a specified control policy
description_zh: 获取指定控制策略生效用户范围
kebab_example: aliyun yundun-bastionhost get-policy-user-scope --instance-id bastion-xxxx-xx --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --policy-id 1 --region cn-hangzhou
name: GetPolicyUserScope

parameters.help_en:
The instance ID of the bastion host to which the control policy belongs.
You can invoke the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/153281.html operation to obtain this parameter
parameters.help_zh:
指定要查询的控制策略所在堡垒机的实例ID。
您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/153281.html接口获取该参数
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The region ID of the bastion host instance to which the control policy belongs.
For the mapping between region IDs and region names, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/40654.html
parameters.help_zh:
指定要查询的控制策略所在堡垒机的区域ID。
区域ID和区域名称的对应关系，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/40654.html
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the control policy to query.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2758876.html operation to obtain this parameter
parameters.help_zh:
指定要查询的控制策略ID。

您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2758876.html接口获取该参数
parameters.name: policy_id

RequestId.description_en: The unique request ID generated by Alibaba Cloud for this request
RequestId.description_zh: 阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符

UserScope.description_en: The effective user scope of the control policy
UserScope.description_zh: 控制策略生效的用户范围

ScopeType.description_en:
The effective user scope of the control policy.

If All is returned, the policy applies to all users.
If an empty value is returned, the policy applies to specified users. The specific scope is indicated by the values of UserGroupIds and UserIds
ScopeType.description_zh:
控制策略生效的用户范围。

返回 All 时表示策略针对所有用户生效。
返回空值表示策略对指定用户生效，具体生效范围为UserGroupIds和UserIds的返回值

UserGroupIds.description_en: The user groups to which the control policy applies
UserGroupIds.description_zh: 控制策略生效的用户组范围

UserIds.description_en: The effective user scope of the control policy
UserIds.description_zh: 控制策略生效的用户范围
